name: Scenario 1: Checkout Service OOMKilled
incident_prompt: The checkout service is experiencing high 5xx error rate and container restarts.

ground_truth.root_cause: Container memory exhaustion caused by unconstrained memory leak in checkout-service, exceeding 512Mi limit and triggering kernel OOMKilled.
ground_truth.trigger: Unbounded cache growth in request handler under moderate load.
symptoms: Elevated 503 Service Unavailable errors during pod restart cycles
